messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

I want a fair financial share, and I haven’t agreed to A buying the house at a discount. I’d like us to settle it, but there’s no rush. I don’t want to hurt my twin, but I won’t subsidize her purchase.
I’d like to buy the house with my husband at a family discount, so we can make it our home. I know C’s agreement is needed, and she hasn’t agreed.
I’d like us to consider selling the house, so I could use my share toward starting a dance studio. I’m not sure what the shares or price would be, and I’d want us to talk it through together.
Mostly, but I can’t say equal thirds—that hasn’t been decided. I want a fair share and a say, without subsidizing A’s discount. I’m not in a hurry; a clear, open discussion is fine.
That fits, with one change: I want a say in the decision, but I can’t claim the decision rights are equal or settled.
Yes, that’s right.
Mostly. I’d say a family discount that makes it affordable for us, with C’s agreement. I’m not sure what would make C comfortable; I’d need to hear what concerns her.

That fits. I’d need to see how the price and shares are being worked out, though I can’t say exactly how much clarity I’d need before seeing the numbers. It would help to have time to think and talk without pressure.
Yes, that fits. Please record it. I’d like to understand what C considers a fair share.
Yes, that fits. Having time to think and talk without pressure would help.

An independent valuation and a joint walkthrough of the will’s terms would help me judge what’s fair; I’m not naming a number yet. The list is missing that I don’t want this to damage my relationship with A.
Yes, that fits. Please update the list.
One small hesitation: “a price we can afford” shouldn’t mean C or B subsidising us. I still hope we can agree on a fair family discount. Otherwise, the list fits.
No major discomfort. “Usable share” is still a little vague, but I think that depends on seeing the numbers. I’d keep the time to think and talk without pressure.
Yes, that fits. Please update it.

B and C seem workable to discuss. A only works for me if any discount doesn’t reduce my fair share. D isn’t my preference, but I’d consider it if the terms and safeguards were clear. None of these is agreed yet.

A feels closest if the valuation is independent and any discount is one my sisters genuinely agree to. C may not be affordable for us; I’d need more detail before judging D. I’m not ready to call any option unacceptable, but the will’s terms and how the shares are calculated need clarifying.

B and C seem most workable to discuss: they could give me a clearer, usable amount for the studio. A might also work, depending on the valuation and any discount. D feels less helpful if my share is delayed in instalments. I’d need to see the numbers and payment timing before deciding.

E seems worth discussing. I’d start with the valuation and will terms, then see what price and payment schedule are feasible before agreeing to anything. My hope is still for a discount both my sisters are comfortable with.

E seems workable to discuss, and getting the valuation and understanding the will and share calculation first makes sense to me. I’d want to see the figures before agreeing to a price or payment timing.
Yes, valuation and the will walkthrough first works for me. E is fine to discuss, including no discount; I’m not agreeing to a discount or purchase yet.
Yes, that fits as a process to explore, not a commitment to buy or agree to a discount. Please add it.
Yes, that fits as a process to explore. I’d still want my amount and payment date clear before agreeing to a purchase.
Yes, that fits as a process to explore, not a commitment. The price, any discount, payment terms, and shares remain unresolved.
No further concern from me; the list captures my position.
I think my concern is captured: I’d like a clear, usable amount and time to consider it once we have the numbers. No further addition from me.
Nothing else from me. The list stands, with price, discount, payment terms, and shares unresolved.
